# Which aged units should you wholesale today, and when should the rest go?

> Paste your used-car inventory and get each unit's true carrying cost on the floorplan, the exact best day to wholesale it, which units to wholesale now ranked by earnings per $1,000 of line per day, and what waiting until it sells leaves behind. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
